# Pipe queries over the tests' tables, run by GoogleSQL's execute_query 2026.11.1 over the same
# rows: each query, its columns and their types, and its rows as the table mode prints them,
# sorted, or its error.
# Generated by scratch/projects/pipe-parser/queries/record_queries.py from cases_5b.txt.
FROM t |> SELECT x, (FROM u |> AGGREGATE MAX(x) AS m) AS biggest	["x INT64", "biggest INT64"]	[["1", "4"], ["2", "4"], ["3", "4"]]
FROM t |> WHERE x < (FROM u |> AGGREGATE MIN(x))	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["1", "a"]]
FROM t |> SELECT x, (FROM u |> WHERE u.x = t.x |> SELECT s) AS other	["x INT64", "other STRING"]	[["1", "NULL"], ["2", "b"], ["3", "c"]]
FROM t |> SELECT (FROM u) AS v	ERROR	Scalar subquery cannot have more than one column unless using SELECT AS STRUCT to build STRUCT values
FROM t |> SELECT (FROM u |> WHERE x > 10 |> SELECT s) AS v	["v STRING"]	[["NULL"], ["NULL"], ["NULL"]]
FROM t |> WHERE EXISTS (FROM u |> WHERE u.x = t.x)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"]]
FROM t |> WHERE NOT EXISTS (FROM u |> WHERE u.x = t.x)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["1", "a"]]
FROM t |> WHERE x IN (FROM u |> SELECT x)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"]]
FROM t |> WHERE x NOT IN (FROM u |> WHERE x > 2 |> SELECT x)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["1", "a"], ["2", "b"]]
FROM t |> WHERE x IN (FROM u |> SELECT x * 1.0)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"]]
FROM t |> WHERE x IN (FROM u |> SELECT s)	ERROR	Cannot execute IN subquery with uncomparable types INT64 and STRING
FROM t |> WHERE x IN (FROM u)	ERROR	Subquery of type IN must have only one output column
FROM t |> SELECT x, ARRAY(FROM u |> WHERE u.x >= t.x |> SELECT x |> ORDER BY x DESC) AS xs	["x INT64", "xs ARRAY<INT64>"]	[["1", "[4, 3, 2]"], ["2", "[4, 3, 2]"], ["3", "[4, 3]"]]
FROM t |> SELECT ARRAY(FROM u |> WHERE FALSE |> SELECT x) AS xs	["xs ARRAY<INT64>"]	[["[]"], ["[]"], ["[]"]]
FROM t |> SELECT ARRAY(FROM u) AS xs	ERROR	ARRAY subquery cannot have more than one column unless using SELECT AS STRUCT to build STRUCT values
FROM t AS a |> WHERE EXISTS (FROM u |> WHERE EXISTS (FROM t AS c |> WHERE c.x = u.x AND c.x = a.x))	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["2", "b"], ["3", "NULL"]]
FROM UNNEST([3, 1, 2]) AS v	["`$value` INT64"]	[["1"], ["2"], ["3"]]
FROM UNNEST([3, 1, 2]) AS v WITH OFFSET	["v INT64", "offset INT64"]	[["1", "1"], ["2", "2"], ["3", "0"]]
FROM UNNEST(['a', 'b']) AS v WITH OFFSET AS i |> SELECT i, v	["i INT64", "v STRING"]	[["0", "a"], ["1", "b"]]
FROM UNNEST([1, 2])	["`$unnest1` INT64"]	[["1"], ["2"]]
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS a, 'p' AS b), STRUCT(2, 'q')]) AS s |> SELECT s.a, b	["a INT64", "b STRING"]	[["1", "p"], ["2", "q"]]
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS a, 'p' AS b), STRUCT(2, 'q')]) |> SELECT a, b	["a INT64", "b STRING"]	[["1", "p"], ["2", "q"]]
FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3] AS n, ['a'] AS c)	["n INT64", "c STRING"]	[["1", "a"], ["2", "NULL"], ["3", "NULL"]]
FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3] AS n, ['a', 'b'] AS c, mode => 'TRUNCATE')	["n INT64", "c STRING"]	[["1", "a"], ["2", "b"]]
FROM UNNEST(5)	ERROR	Values referenced in UNNEST must be arrays. UNNEST contains expression of type INT64
FROM arrays, UNNEST(arrays.xs) AS x |> SELECT k, x	["k INT64", "x INT64"]	[["1", "1"], ["1", "2"]]
FROM arrays |> CROSS JOIN UNNEST(xs) AS x WITH OFFSET AS o |> SELECT k, x, o	["k INT64", "x INT64", "o INT64"]	[["1", "1", "0"], ["1", "2", "1"]]
FROM arrays |> LEFT JOIN UNNEST(xs) AS x |> SELECT k, x	["k INT64", "x INT64"]	[["1", "1"], ["1", "2"], ["2", "NULL"], ["3", "NULL"]]
FROM arrays |> JOIN UNNEST(xs) AS x ON x > 1 |> SELECT k, x	["k INT64", "x INT64"]	[["1", "2"]]
FROM arrays AS a |> CROSS JOIN UNNEST(a.xs) AS x |> AGGREGATE SUM(x) AS total GROUP BY k	["k INT64", "total INT64"]	[["1", "3"]]
FROM arrays |> SELECT k, (FROM UNNEST(xs) AS x |> AGGREGATE SUM(x)) AS total	["k INT64", "total INT64"]	[["1", "3"], ["2", "NULL"], ["3", "NULL"]]
FROM arrays |> WHERE 2 IN UNNEST(xs)	["k INT64", "xs ARRAY<INT64>"]	[["1", "[1, 2]"]]
FROM t, LATERAL (FROM u |> WHERE u.x <= t.x |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n) |> SELECT x, n	["x INT64", "n INT64"]	[["1", "0"], ["2", "1"], ["3", "2"]]
FROM t |> JOIN LATERAL (FROM u |> WHERE u.x < t.x |> SELECT x AS y) ON TRUE |> SELECT x, y	["x INT64", "y INT64"]	[["3", "2"]]
FROM t, (FROM u |> WHERE u.x <= t.x)	ERROR	Unrecognized name: t
FROM t |> WITH w AS (FROM u |> WHERE x > 2), v AS (FROM w |> SELECT x * 10 AS y) |> CROSS JOIN v	["x INT64", "s STRING", "y INT64"]	[["1", "a", "30"], ["1", "a", "40"], ["2", "b", "30"], ["2", "b", "40"], ["3", "NULL", "30"], ["3", "NULL", "40"]]
FROM t |> WITH w AS (FROM u |> WHERE x = 2) |> WHERE x IN (FROM w |> SELECT x)	["x INT64", "s STRING"]	[["2", "b"]]
FROM t |> WITH w AS (FROM u) |> JOIN w AS a USING (x) |> JOIN w AS b USING (x)	["x INT64", "s STRING", "s STRING", "s STRING"]	[["2", "b", "b", "b"], ["3", "NULL", "c", "c"]]
FROM w |> WITH w AS (FROM u)	ERROR	Table not found: w
FROM t |> WITH w AS (FROM t |> SELECT x AS y) |> CROSS JOIN w |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n	["n INT64"]	[["9"]]
FROM (FROM t |> WITH w AS (FROM u) |> CROSS JOIN w) |> CROSS JOIN w	ERROR	Table not found: w (Unqualified identifiers in a FROM clause are always resolved as tables. Identifier w is in scope but unqualified names cannot be resolved here.)
FROM t |> SELECT x, ARRAY(FROM u |> WHERE u.x = t.x |> SELECT s) AS xs	["x INT64", "xs ARRAY<STRING>"]	[["1", "[]"], ["2", "[b]"], ["3", "[c]"]]
FROM t, LATERAL (FROM u |> WHERE u.x = t.x |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n) |> SELECT x, n	["x INT64", "n INT64"]	[["1", "0"], ["2", "1"], ["3", "1"]]
FROM t |> JOIN LATERAL (FROM u |> WHERE u.x = t.x |> SELECT s AS y) ON TRUE |> SELECT x, y	["x INT64", "y STRING"]	[["2", "b"], ["3", "c"]]
FROM t |> LEFT JOIN LATERAL (FROM u |> WHERE u.x = t.x |> SELECT s AS y) ON TRUE |> SELECT x, y	["x INT64", "y STRING"]	[["1", "NULL"], ["2", "b"], ["3", "c"]]
